title: JSON Schema for pkgpin configuration
description: Configuration schema for pkgpin (package.json dependency pinner and updater)

$schema.description: JSON schema URI for configuration validation

prefix.description: Version prefix to apply when updating dependencies. Use "" (default) for exact pinned versions, "^" for caret, or "~" for tilde.

preservePrefix.description: Keep whatever prefix (^ or ~) each dependency currently has instead of replacing it with the global prefix setting.

exclude.description: List of package names to skip from updating (e.g. ["typescript", "eslint"]).

target.description: List of specific package names to update. If empty or omitted, all dependencies are targeted.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel HTTP requests to registry when resolving versions.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds when querying the npm registry.

dryRun.description: Preview changes without modifying package.json files on disk.

paths.description: Explicit target file or directory paths to process when no positional paths are passed to CLI.

workspaces.description: Per-workspace configuration overrides in monorepos, mapped by directory path, package name, or glob pattern.
